required_checks: exact input, lexicon, model, voice, output, receipt, ASR, and validator digest binding
hard three-hundred-character synthesis-call ceiling with exact written-token preservation
no internal ASR omission spanning more than eight expected content tokens
finite mono samples with no digital clipping
normal visual-abstract duration of two-and-a-half to four-and-a-half minutes, with longer work requiring an explicit editorial rationale
animatic caption timing derived from the exact narration receipt and final timing withheld until a pinned aligner passes qualification
final A/V codec, geometry, frame-rate, audio, and duration checks

alignment.animatic_timing_source: Exact synthesis-block durations recorded in the narration receipt.
alignment.picture_and_sound_lock_requirement: Every picture-and-sound lock must bind a passing exact-text phrase-alignment receipt and a distinct zero-failure manual anchor review for that exact narration and beat plan.
alignment.admission_test: Require exact normalized transcript coverage, monotonic non-overlapping words, bounded beginning, ending, and generation-join drift, unique positive-duration beat anchors, four diverse chapter pilots, and full-speed auditory review; reject any dropped, duplicated, clipped, or misplaced required phrase.
alignment.qualified_scope: phrase anchors, caption lines, and generation-block joins only
alignment.residual_policy: The qualified route is phrase-scoped, not phoneme-scoped. Any instantaneous single-word timestamp is ineligible as a cue boundary; every production cue must use a positive-duration reviewed phrase span, and every chapter still requires a distinct manual anchor review before picture-and-sound lock.

rights_and_disclosure.required_video_description_disclosure: Narration is synthetic and generated locally with Kokoro-82M using the af_heart voice.

execution_boundary.residual_risk: The local TTS and ASR dependencies are pinned and receive local model paths, but the current adapter is not an operating-system sandbox.

storage_boundary.tracked: scripts, locks, lexicon, contracts, captions, and digest receipts
storage_boundary.ignored: model weights, virtual environments, raw audio, ASR output, and final media under build/visual_edition

upgrade_gate: Run a matched-excerpt voice audition plus terminology, intelligibility, rights, compute, loudness, alignment, caption, mux, and five-pilot visual review before adoption.
non_claims: Automated transcript agreement does not prove that every listener will prefer the voice.
A qualified narration toolchain does not make an unvalidated chapter video publishable.
Open-source licensing does not create a warranty or erase platform disclosure duties.
Synthetic narration does not change any book claim or evidence state.
ASR agreement and synthesis-block durations are not forced alignment and cannot close picture-and-sound lock.
A virtual environment and offline library hints are not operating-system network or credential isolation.
